visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a tiled indoor floor where two Corgis with tan and white fur are standing. One dog is in the foreground, looking up at the camera with its tongue slightly out, while the other stands further back near a cardboard box and a black perforated basket. A person's feet wearing dark sandals are visible at the bottom edge of the frame. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting daylight entering from an open storefront or window. (2) The two dogs begin to interact more dynamically, moving towards each other in the center of the frame. They engage in playful nipping and mouth-wrestling. The camera is handheld and tilts down to follow their movements as they circle the person's feet. In the background, green plastic crates filled with produce are visible, indicating a retail or market setting. (3) The playful altercation intensifies as the dogs move between several stacked green crates. One dog lunges playfully while the other retreats and then counters. Their facial expressions show open mouths and alert ears. The setting remains consistent with a flat tiled floor and various market-related objects like crates and boxes scattered around. (4) One Corgi rolls onto its back in a submissive, playful gesture while the other continues to nip at its neck and chest. The camera captures a close-up of their faces; the dog on the ground has wide eyes and a gaping mouth. The lighting creates strong shadows on the floor. The background shows the entrance to a shop with more crates and outdoor scenery beyond. (5) The dogs move towards a child sitting on a black stool at a small table. The child is wearing blue patterned pajamas. A person's hand enters the frame holding a clear plastic water bottle labeled 'H2O'. The person uses the bottle to gently tap and direct the dogs away from the child. One dog briefly balances the bottle on its head. The overall environment is a busy, lived-in space with shoes and household items visible.
